verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Isaiah 44

Cyrus named "more than 200 years before" his birth (Poole); "my shepherd" = the LORD's appointed carer (Motyer); Ezra records only the foundation laid under Cyrus; many modern scholars take the passage as the strongest argument for an exilic author; Guzik: the name cannot have been inserted later; Motyer: we cannot limit predictive prophecy; Josephus's Cyrus-read-Isaiah report via Bultema (220 years)
